review.subtitle: Tissot PRX Powermatic 80 35 mm, green waffle dial, integrated steel bracelet. Front relief GLB, round 1.
notes: Built from Tissot's official straight-on render (the supplied photo is angled; it is kept as the 3/4 reference).

Modelled: brushed case running into the bracelet with a polished edge, wide polished bezel, applied polished batons (double at 12) with a lume inset, polished date frame, faceted hour and minute hands with lume strips, seconds hand with counterweight, fluted crown, integrated tapering H-link bracelet with the house curl.
From the photo map: green waffle dial, minute track, TISSOT 1853, PRX Powermatic 80, Swiss Made and the date disc. The white print is redrawn sharp at 4x the render's resolution.
Heights are a front-relief reading of the official 10.93 mm case.
